Oleshky ceasefire begins, Budanov says
events.detail: A ceasefire to allow humanitarian aid to enter the Russian occupied city began as Russian forces launched ballistic missiles at other parts of Ukraine.

events.quote: Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv kills one, injures 10 and damages medical facilities and school
events.detail: During the air raid alert in the capital, explosions were heard—Russian forces attacked the city with ballistic missiles.

events.quote: Air defenses neutralize two ballistic missiles, 255 drones in overnight Russian attack on Ukraine
events.detail: Ukraine’s air defense forces shot down two ballistic missiles and neutralized 255 drones launched by Russian forces against Ukraine beginning on the evening of October 26.

events.quote: ⚡️ В течение прошедшей ночи дежурными силами ПВО перехвачены и уничтожены 222 украинских беспилотных летательных аппарата самолетного типа над территориями Новгородской, Тверской, Белгородской, Брянской, Курской, Калужской, Орловской, Тульской, Воронежской, Смоленской, Ростовской областей, Краснодарского края, Республ…
More than 40 sets of World War II remains exhumed in Mlyniv, Rivne region
events.detail: In the village of Mlyniv in the Rivne region, search teams exhumed more than 40 sets of human remains of people who died during World War II; these remains were later reburied at the Memorial of Glory.

events.quote: War update: 196 combat engagements on frontline in past day as Russian pressure intensifies  on Pokrovsk, Kostiantynivka axes
events.detail: A total of 196 combat engagements between Ukraine’s Defense Forces and Russian troops were reported along the front line on October 26.

events.quote: Three killed, eight injured in Russian attacks on Kharkiv Region over past day
events.detail: Three people were killed and eight others injured in Russian attacks on Kharkiv and 12 other settlements in the Kharkiv region over the past day.

events.source_name: General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine
events.quote: Оперативна інформація станом на 08:00 27.10.2026 щодо російського вторгнення Слава Україні!
Russia expanding recruitment of African mercenaries amid heavy losses in Ukraine war – Bloomberg
events.detail: Russia is expanding the range of African countries from which it recruits men to address a shortage of personnel in its armed forces amid the war against Ukraine, where it is suffering heavy losses.

events.quote: Russia loses another 1,400 troops in war against Ukraine in past 24 hours
events.detail: Total combat losses among Russian troops since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine—from February 24, 2022, to October 27, 2026—amount to approximately 1,581,840 personnel, including 1,400 over the past 24 hours.

events.quote: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,581,840 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
events.detail: Russia has lost 1,581,840 troops in Ukraine since the beginning of its full-scale invasion on Feb.

events.quote: New report tracks how Russia helps China build better drones
events.detail: The investigation found that Russian designs for rocket-launched drones likely helped shape weapons China unveiled in 2025 and that Russian wind tunnels kept testing aircraft models for China's top arms maker after the invasion of Ukraine.

events.quote: Ukraine reportedly strikes Russian ammunition depot in occupied Luhansk Oblast
events.detail: Ukraine used strike drones in an attack that took several hours near the city of Khrustalnyi, according to Ukrainian monitoring channel Exilenova Plus.

events.quote: Zelensky after Russian strike on Kyiv: Delays in air defense support Ukraine enable terrorism
events.detail: Amid the constant threat of Russian airstrikes, artificial delays in the delivery of air defense systems to protect Ukraine only serve to fuel terror.

events.quote: Russia's assault on Ukraine's energy grid is a war crime, UN says
events.detail: Russia’s attacks on energy infrastructure, which weaponize winter to inflict suffering, amount to war crimes, a UN inquiry has found.

events.quote: Specialists assess damage to Kyiv’s Southern Bridge after ballistic missile strike
events.detail: Specialists are assessing damage to Kyiv’s Southern Bridge following a Russian ballistic missile strike overnight on October 27.

events.quote: Most of Konotop without power for fourth day after Russian Strikes; water supplied on schedule
events.detail: Much of Konotop, in Ukraine’s Sumy region, has been without electricity for the fourth consecutive day following Russian strikes.
